summary.title_hr: PODCAST MREŽNICA - don Lukač:Da bismo preživjeli dolazeći val sekularizma treba iskustvo živog Boga!
summary.abstract_hr: Don Tomislav Lukač, salezijanac i svećenik posvećen radu s mladima, gostuje u podcastu Mrežnica. Razgovara se o njegovoj evangelizaciji putem društvenih mreža, motivaciji za takav pristup te izazovima s kojima se mladi danas suočavaju, poput problema u vezama, mentalnog zdravlja i utjecaja pornografije. Don Tomo uspoređuje stanje vjere među mladima u Hrvatskoj i zapadnoj Europi, naglašavajući važnost osobnog iskustva živog Boga za preživljavanje nadolazećeg vala sekularizma. Također dijeli osobno svjedočanstvo o svom svećeničkom pozivu i stavove o kontroverznim temama poput Thompsona i Severine.
key_topics: vjera u Hrvatskoj i zapadnoj Europi
key_points: Don Tomislav Lukač evangelizira mlade putem društvenih mreža, objavljujući videe na različite teme, potaknut krizmanicima koji su prepoznali njegovu sposobnost slikovitog prenošenja vjere.
Kroz svoj rad na društvenim mrežama, Don Tomo nastoji razbiti krivu sliku o Crkvi i Bogu, potaknuti mlade na molitvu i ispovijed, te im pomoći u suočavanju s osobnim problemima i dilemama.
Mladi se danas suočavaju s problemima poput gubitka volje za životom, utjecaja pornografije, besciljnosti i nedostatka ljubavi, što ih navodi na traženje sreće na krivim mjestima.
Don Tomo naglašava da je brak sredstvo za postizanje svetosti i da je u mješovitim brakovima ključno pitanje odgoja djece u vjeri, što je često prepreka.
Hrvatski mladi se ističu po aktivnom življenju vjere i molitvi, za razliku od zapadne Europe gdje je Crkva 'spustila letvicu', što se očituje i u broju duhovnih zvanja.
Za preživljavanje nadolazećeg vala sekularizma u Hrvatskoj, ključno je iskustvo živog Boga, a ne samo oslanjanje na tradiciju.
Osobno svjedočanstvo Don Tomislava Lukača o njegovom svećeničkom pozivu opisuje kao slaganje 'puzzli' Božjih znakova, uključujući obiteljsku priču i susret sa salezijancima.
Molitva je definirana kao dopuštanje Bogu da pokaže koliko nas ljubi, te je ključna za osjećaj Božje prisutnosti i vodstva u svakodnevnom životu.
mentioned_organizations: Institut za brak i obitelj (papinski institut Ivana Pavla II)
summary.title_en: PODCAST MREŽNICA - don Lukač: In order to survive the coming wave of secularism, the experience of the living God is needed!
summary.abstract_en: Don Tomislav Lukač, a Salesian and a priest dedicated to working with youth, is a guest on the Mrežnica podcast. They discuss his evangelization through social networks, the motivation for such an approach, and the challenges that young people face today, such as relationship problems, mental health, and the influence of pornography. Don Tomo compares the state of faith among youth in Hrvatska and Western Europe, emphasizing the importance of a personal experience of the living God for surviving the upcoming wave of secularism. He also shares a personal testimony about his priestly vocation and views on controversial topics such as Thompson and Severina.
key_topics_en: the role of the priest in modern society
faith in Croatia and Western Europe
key_points_en: Don Tomislav Lukač evangelizes young people through social networks, publishing videos on various topics, prompted by confirmation candidates who recognized his ability of vivid transmission of the faith.

Through his work on social media, Don Tomo strives to break the false image of the Church and God, encourage young people to prayer and confession, and help them in facing personal problems and dilemmas.
Young people today face problems such as the loss of the will to live, the influence of pornography, aimlessness, and a lack of love, which leads them to seek happiness in the wrong places.
Don Tomo emphasizes that marriage is a means for achieving holiness and that in mixed marriages the key issue is raising children in the faith, which is often an obstacle.
Croatian youth stand out by the active living of faith and prayer, unlike Western Europe where the Church has 'lowered the bar', which is also manifested in the number of spiritual vocations.
For surviving the coming wave of secularism in Croatia, the experience of the living God is crucial, and not only relying on tradition.
The personal testimony of Don Tomislav Lukač about his priestly vocation describes it as putting together 'puzzles' of God's signs, including a family story and an encounter with the Salesians.
Prayer is defined as allowing God to show how much He loves us, and is crucial for the feeling of God's presence and guidance in everyday life.
mentioned_organizations_en: Institute for Marriage and Family (Pontifical Institute of Ivan Pavao II)
